name: Gooseberry
siboNotes: Well tolerated in SIBO diets as it's naturally low FODMAP and doesn't contain fermentable carbohydrates that feed bacterial overgrowth.
preparationTips: Remove papery husks from cape gooseberries before eating
Can be eaten fresh or cooked in jams and desserts
Store ripe berries in refrigerator for up to one week
Wash gently just before consuming to prevent premature spoilage
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C for immune support
Good source of vitamin A for eye health
Provides dietary fiber for digestive health
